name: animated-list
blurb: Self-animating list that cycles child items with scale and fade entrance.
description: Wrapper component that auto-plays a sequence of list item animations. Each child wraps in AnimatedListItem with configurable delay between cycles. Uses Framer Motion for spring-based scale and opacity transitions.
use_when: Notification lists, activity feeds, or demo showcases where auto-playing animated items draw attention. Commonly used in dashboard widgets.
avoid_when: Static content lists or when user attention should focus elsewhere. Continuous animation can be distracting and impact performance.
a11y: No ARIA attributes or focus management. Animations are visual-only; content accessibility depends on structure of children.
